rows.label: qst640406_msg0002
rows.name:
I see. My beloved daughter Renata sent
you as reinforcements.

rows.label: qst640406_msg0004
rows.name:
You know this Geothermal Mining Plant
needs repairs, right?

rows.label: qst640406_msg0005
rows.name:
Amir put me in charge of repairs on
this second floor, but...

rows.label: qst640406_msg0006
rows.name:
Swarm Bees are nesting in front of the
faulty equipment.

rows.label: qst640406_msg0007
rows.name:
If you can take them out, I can start
the repairs right away, but...

rows.label: qst640406_msg0008
rows.name:
You really are reliable. Just what I'd
expect from the Drivers my daughter
chose.

rows.label: qst640406_msg0009
rows.name:
Take out the Swarm Bees and Swarm
Nest, and we're set.

rows.label: qst640406_msg0101
rows.name:
Take out the Swarm Bees and Swarm Nest
for me.

rows.label: qst640406_msg0102
rows.name:
Then I'll be able to repair the
equipment. Leave the rest to me.

rows.label: qst640406_msg0201
rows.name:
Looks like you cleared out the Swarm
Bees.

rows.label: qst640406_msg0202
rows.name: Thanks. Now I can make the repairs.

rows.label: qst640406_msg0203
rows.name:
Wait for me, Renata. I'll be home
soon!

rows.label: qst640406_msg0204
rows.name:
With Papa on it, repairs like this
take only seconds!
